explanation: The theorem concerns library-specific objects: DivisorialWeilPairingData, Pic0.torsion of the X1(N) function field, the semilinear Galois action on JOne N, and inertia subgroups of valuation subrings. Mathlib has none of these definitions, so no Mathlib declaration can state the same result. The proof combines the library's own lemmas (pair_semilinearSmul, pair_sub_left, pair_nsmul_left) with a lemma on inertia acting trivially on roots of unity of order prime to p. I did not run searches of the Mathlib sources.
